# Kettle

Old Furze's granddaughter, about eight, the size of a rat, in a knitted jumper with the sleeves rolled four times. She found the Fell under the barley and has decided they are hers.

She runs messages, gets underfoot and finds things out first. She found the Fell under the barley, she knows her grandad better than he does, and she will tell anyone how to sit on a raft. She is never in danger on the page. When things go bad she is already somewhere safe, shouting advice. She gets the last word in every ending.
